name: Golden Horde Feudal All-in with Khan & Torguuds
author: Eldritch

notes: Queue 2 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ batches and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@
Send 4 to @resource/sheep.webp@

Send 1 to build @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@ then @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ (near @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if front because you'll make @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ later on it) and then go @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Send 1 of the 2 new @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build @building_mongols/ger.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and mine
Keep 2 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@@resource/sheep.webp@ until age-up
Age-up with @technology_golden_horde/golden_tent_khan_age2.webp@
Send 6 @resource/sheep.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ the next two to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ as well
Then @resource/rally.webp@ back to @resource/resource_food.webp@

Produce @unit_golden_horde/khan.webp@ and @unit_golden_horde/torguud.webp@ from @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ and send to enemy @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to harass, try to keep him alive, dodge @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@
Send 1 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to build @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ near @landmark_golden_horde/golden_tent.webp@ with space for future @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@
Build @building_mongols/ger.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ when necessary
Produce 1 @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ batch and rally to the enemy base
Continue producing @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@
Research @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@
Produce @unit_golden_horde/torguud.webp@ as soon as you have 160 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ and rally to enemy base, heal @unit_golden_horde/khan.webp@ if necessary

Once 11 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ then @resource/rally.webp@ @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 14 then send 2-3 more @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Build @building_golden_horde/fortified_outpost.webp@ near your production
Build second production building when necessary, according to enemy composition
Whenever possible build @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and research @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ and @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@
Research @technology_military/siege-engineering.webp@ if enemy goes 2 TC and you're in a safe position to push it with 2 rams

description: A Build Order to go aggro all-in in Feudal, with Khan & Torguuds + Archers. You can aggro a bit earlier than with Building Carts and produce Torguuds more consistently. Aggressive strat best to deal with civs you don't want to play the long game against like Knights Templars or Ottomans.
